metadata.source: Prospect Park Borough Municipal Directory & School Board Rosters

staff.name: Prospect Park Borough Executive Leadership
staff.title: Mayor / Municipal Executive
staff.notes: Leads Prospect Park Borough municipal governing body and presides over public policy meetings.

staff.name: Municipal Administrator
staff.title: Business Administrator / CAO
staff.notes: Directs day-to-day municipal operations, department heads, and labor collective bargaining.

staff.name: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
staff.title: Certified Municipal Finance Officer (CMFO)
staff.notes: Oversees municipal debt service, annual operating budget preparation, and tax billing.

staff.name: Chief of Police
staff.title: Police Chief & Public Safety Executive
staff.notes: Commands uniformed patrol, emergency 911 communications, detective bureau, and traffic safety.

staff.name: Certified Tax Assessor
staff.title: Tax Assessor (CTA)
staff.notes: Maintains certified MOD-IV property assessment roll and defends assessments before Passaic County Tax Board.

staff.name: Superintendent of Schools
staff.title: District Superintendent
staff.notes: Chief administrative and instructional officer for Prospect Park Borough public school district.

staff.name: School Business Administrator
staff.title: Board Secretary & SBA
staff.notes: Manages public school annual operating budget, facilities capital bonds, and state aid accounting.
